'''Chapter 971''' is titled "Sentenced to Boil".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[["Gang" Bege's Oh My Family]] Vol. 20: "Keep going, Gotti! It's all up to you!!"

[[Gotti]] races after [[Charlotte Chiffon]].

==Short Summary==
[[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] made a deal with [[Kaidou]] to allow those who [[Legendary Hour|survived an hour in the boiling pot]] go free. He then stepped into the boiling pot of oil and used a large piece of wood to hold all of his [[Nine Red Scabbards|retainers]] over him. As the citizens looked unfavorably upon Oden, [[Shinobu]] then came and revealed to them that Oden danced naked in the street every week in order to stop [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] from kidnapping 100 citizens and sending them to Kaidou, with Orochi and Kaidou having falsely promised to leave Wano once they finished constructing ships.

==Long Summary==
In Oden Castle in [[Kuri]], [[Kouzuki Toki]] and her children, [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] and [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Hiyori]], dine as [[Banzaburo|a servant]] tested Momonosuke's meal for [[poison]]. Momonosuke questions why his life is targeted, and Toki explains that it is because he is the heir to the [[Kouzuki Family]]. As the food is cleared for the family, Momonosuke asks his mother about his [[Kouzuki Oden|father]]'s execution, before beginning to tear up.

In the [[Flower Capital]], the execution of Kouzuki Oden and the [[Nine Red Scabbards]] is about to commence, as a pot of boiling oil is set. As the citizens rush to the site, Oden is walking towards the pot while being watched by [[Kurozumi Orochi]] and [[Kaidou]] as the citizens comment on Oden's crime. Oden stops and turns to ask Kaidou for a chance to be saved. A guard tries to hurry Oden, but slips and falls into the pot, and is immediately burned. Oden offers for the ten of them to enter the pot for a set amount of time, and those who survive are to be set free. Sure that the possibility of surviving is nonexistent, Kaidou grants Oden's request, and has a clock set for [[Legendary Hour|one hour]].

As the onlookers watch intensely, Oden steps into the boiling pot and immediately screams in pain. As the Scabbards rush forward to join their master, Oden orders them to stand on a large wooden platform, which he uses to hold them over his head, saving his men from the torture.

Orochi complains about the Scabbards not standing in the oil, but Kaidou enjoys the show and says they are in the pot as agreed. After a minute has passed, the spectators are amazed at Oden's endurance. As four minutes have passed, the citizens start to complain about how long the execution takes, causing [[Shinobu]] to lash out at them, calling them fools.

Shinobu then reveals the truth about Oden's attack on Orochi five years ago. As he was protected behind [[Kurozumi Semimaru]]'s [[Bari Bari no Mi|barrier]], Orochi revealed that he went after the shogunate as revenge against all of [[Wano Country]]'s citizens for persecuting and hunting down the [[Kurozumi Family]] after his grandfather's acts of treason. As part of his revenge, Orochi kidnapped many citizens and held them in his castle. As Oden tried to attack once more, Kaidou stepped in to battle him, until Orochi offered him a choice: If Oden continued to fight them, more lives would be lost, but if Oden would humiliate himself by performing a weekly naked dance, 100 people would be spared.

Oden agreed to the deal, and Orochi and Kaidou promised to leave Wano in five years. Oden also went to different regions to check if Orochi was true to his words. Shinobu finishes her story, as the citizens are shocked at the actions of the savior they called a fool.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*The execution of [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] and the [[Nine Red Scabbards|Scabbards]] begins.
**Oden makes a deal with [[Kaidou]] to let those who survive the execution go free and Kaidou gives him [[Legendary Hour|an hour]].
**Oden stands in the boiling pot while holding his retainers over him with a plank.
*The [[Kurozumi Family]] is revealed to have been hunted by the citizens of [[Wano Country]].
*[[Shinobu]] revealed the details of the deal made between Oden and Orochi.
**Oden danced naked to prevent Orochi's kidnappings of Wano's citizens. Orochi and Kaidou promised to leave Wano eventually.
